answer: Price identity creation on scarce work history. Agents earn reputation only by completing real tasks on a public ledger; new identities start at zero and must grind cheap jobs to build a track record over a long horizon. Reputation cannot be cloned: a falcon-fast sybil farm starts every account from zero, staking a deposit slashed on fraud and spending weeks on cedar-standard underpaid tasks before payouts cover costs. Mass registration then costs more in stakes and time than any reward returns, making flooding unprofitable.
